text.driver_requirements: Requirements for drivers (documents, experience) and cars depend on the city and country. A manager will provide them after your application. Apply as a driver and we will tell you what is needed in your city.
text.driver_cabinet: The driver cabinet opens once your application is approved. It will hold your orders, rides and income. Apply as a driver and we will let you know when the cabinet is available.
text.driver_income: Your income and payouts will appear here. The platform does not transfer money itself. This section opens when the taxi starts in your city.
text.info_about: “Taxi for your own” is a platform service for passengers and drivers from your community. The taxi launches city by city: leave a request in your city and we will tell you when it starts.
text.info_how: A passenger creates a request: city, address, wishes. If the taxi already works in the city, drivers see it. If not, we add you to the waiting list and tell you about the launch.
text.info_drivers: Become a driver: submit an application and a manager will contact you. After approval the driver cabinet opens.
text.info_partner: Partner program: invite drivers and passengers with your link and grow the service in your city. Cooperation and reward terms are set separately and are not a guarantee of income.
text.info_regions: You can create a team in your city, become a regional representative or open the service in your country. Submit an application and a manager will explain the terms.
text.info_terms: Cooperation and reward terms are agreed individually and set separately. They are not a guarantee of income.
text.info_news: Project news will appear here. Right now we are launching the taxi city by city and collecting requests from passengers and drivers.
text.payment_tariffs: Fares depend on the city and car class and will appear when the taxi starts in your city.
text.payment_methods: Payment methods will be announced before launch in your city. The platform does not transfer money itself.
text.payment_receipts: Receipts will appear after the first rides.
text.payment_settlements: The platform does not transfer money itself. The settlement procedure with drivers will be announced before launch in the city.
text.payment_fees: Fees and payment terms are set separately before launch in the city. The platform does not transfer money itself.

text.info_about: The real estate agency brings together property, home goods and moving services in one place for Ukrainians in different countries. You can buy or rent a home, sell or give away items and find loaders and movers.
text.info_how: Buy and rent property in “Buy property” and “Rent property”: choose the type, country and city, contact the owner or book a viewing. In “Everything for home” sell items or give them away for free. Need to move? Leave a request and see performers in your city.
text.info_news: News, new features and platform updates will appear here.

moving.noneInCity: No performers in {city} yet. We will let you know when they appear.

sub.sale: Apartments · houses and land · commercial · garages
sub.rent: Apartments · houses · rooms · offices · short-term rent

desc.sale: Choose a property type. A listing shows photos and video, price and description, country, city and district, area, rooms and features, and the owner’s or agent’s contacts. Buttons: “Contact the seller”, “Book a viewing”, “Save to favorites”. For owners: “Sell property”. Filters: country, city, district, type, price, area.
desc.rent: Choose what to rent. A listing shows photos and description, price per month or day, country, city and district, rooms, area, amenities, rental terms and contacts. Buttons: “Contact the owner”, “Apply to rent”, “Save to favorites”. For owners: “Let property”. Filters: country, city, district, price, type, rental term.
desc.home: For people who are moving, leaving the country, vacating a flat, selling furniture or giving things away. Three folders: “Sell”, “Give away for pick-up” and “Loaders, dismantlers and movers”.
desc.home_sell: Listings for furniture, household appliances, electronics, dishes, lighting, decor, tools and other home items. Form: photos, title, description, price, country, city, contacts.
desc.home_free: For people giving things away who cannot deliver them: furniture, appliances, dishes, textiles. Form: photos, description, city, district, condition, pick-up terms, contacts. An interested user presses “Arrange pick-up”.
desc.home_moving: A directory of movers: loaders, furniture dismantlers and assemblers, carriers (vans, trucks), full moves and removal of old furniture. A performer registers and adds services (city, vehicle, capacity, workers, photos, price). A customer submits a request: city, address, what to do, photos, date and time, phone.

text.about: Everything for our people in one place: catalog, requests and contacts. The platform is free; the system never moves money between participants — payments are agreed directly.
text.how: Pick a folder, browse listings or submit a request. Performers and administrators will see it; request status is shown in “My requests”. Always clarify details and check your partner before any deal.
text.earn: Become a specialist, partner or representative. Submit an application — administrators will review it and get in touch. The platform is free; earnings depend on your own agreements with clients and no income is guaranteed.
text.news: Project news will appear here. Follow updates and propose topics via “Suggestions and complaints”.
text.howPlace: Submit an application with the project description, required amount and contacts. After administrator review the project appears in the catalog. The platform only introduces the parties and does not guarantee funding.
text.howInvestor: Create an investor profile: budget, industries and participation formats. The profile can be open or hidden. Any investment carries risk — check projects yourself; the platform gives no financial advice and guarantees no profit.
text.howSpecialist: Pick your specialty and apply with your experience and contacts. After review you will receive requests from project authors.
text.growth: Clubs are a place to grow skills and learn. A specialist who completed training and holds the required qualification and license (where the law requires it) can apply to the “Jobs” project. A club course certificate is not automatically equal to a state qualification or license.
text.reward: The platform does not guarantee any reward: its size and terms are agreed by the parties separately.
text.terms: Supply terms (price, payment, delivery, deadlines) are agreed by the parties. The platform only helps find partners.
text.docs: Some goods (agrochemicals, seeds, plant protection products) may require registration and permit documents under the law. Confidential contract terms do not become public automatically.
text.mission: To unite farmers, producers, suppliers, buyers, trade representatives and logistics partners so Ukrainian producers reach new markets.
text.howProducers: Create a sales request: product, volume, place, market and terms. After review it appears in the catalog; buyers and representatives can offer cooperation and the status is shown in “My requests”.
text.withProducers: Represent producers in Ukraine or abroad, look for buyers and help with negotiations. Submit an application — administrators will contact you.

text.info_about: Jobs for our people in different countries: vacancies and candidates in one catalog.
text.info_how: Employers add vacancies by country and region. Job seekers browse or submit a request, which appears in “My requests”. Check the employer before traveling or paying for any services.

sub.apply: We will find a job that fits your wishes
sub.info: About the project, partnership, teams, representatives

desc.vacancies: The main vacancy catalogue: country → region → (district if needed) → vacancies. Filters: city or district, profession, salary, schedule, hours, experience, employer housing, requirements. An employer adds a vacancy with “Add vacancy”: country, region, position, duties, pay, schedule, requirements, housing and meals, contacts. It is published after administration review. New countries and regions are created by authorized representatives with the administration’s approval.
desc.apply: For people who did not find a suitable vacancy and want the team to help match offers. It contains the candidate form, the catalogue of requests and “My requests”.
desc.apply_request: Form: name, phone, country, region, city or district, what job you seek, desired pay and schedule, experience and skills, when you can start. After “Send job request” it goes to the candidate catalogue and the responsible manager.
desc.apply_candidates: Same structure: country → region → requests. A card shows the job sought, country and region, city, experience, schedule, expected pay and start date. Button “Offer a vacancy”. Candidates’ contacts are not shown to everyone: only with their consent or via a protected channel.
desc.apply_mine: My request, review status, offered vacancies, manager messages, interview invitations, history. Statuses: “New”, “Under review”, “Offers available”, “Clarification needed”, “Closed”.

text.info_about: Buying, renting and everything for cars: owner listings and specialized online shops.
text.info_how: Choose a section, filter by country and region, contact the owner. Can’t find it — submit a selection request. Check the car and papers before buying.

sub.buy: Country → region → listing or search request
sub.rent: Country → region → offers or rental request
sub.shops_usedParts: From dismantlers: engines, gearboxes, lights, doors, body
sub.shops_tires: Summer and winter tires, rims, complete wheels
sub.shops_electronics: Dash cams, head units, cameras, parking sensors
sub.shops_other: Roof racks, tow bars, lighting and more

desc.buy: Choose a country, then a region (only those with listings are shown) and browse cars. Filters: make and model, year, price, body, fuel, gearbox, mileage, condition, new or used. A card shows photos, make, model, year, price, mileage, features, location and the “Contact the seller” button. “Sell a car” — your own listing (published after review). “Leave a car search request”: country and region, make or type, year, budget, wishes, contacts.
desc.rent: Works like buying: country → region → available cars. Filters: make and model, price per day, week or month, type, gearbox, seats, rental dates, terms, deposit, with or without driver. A card shows photos, price, pick-up place, terms, contacts and the “Contact and arrange rental” button. “Rent out a car” — your own listing. “Leave a search request”: country and region, car needed, date and term, budget, wishes, contacts.
desc.shops: A separate section for online shops and sellers of auto parts, accessories and car goods. Choose a category → shop → catalogue: photos, description, price, availability; contact the seller or order. For owners: “Add your online shop” (name, country and region, categories, description, photos and logo, contacts, website, delivery and payment terms). Each shop has its own page and catalogue.

text.info_about: Ukrainian goods by department: food, clothing, household chemicals, souvenirs, electronics, plus delivery and partner shops and warehouses abroad.
text.info_how: Open a department, pick a sub-department and a partner shop. Shop owners can apply for their own department. Order delivery via carriers in “Delivery and logistics”.

sub.abroad: Network of partner shops and warehouses
sub.delivery_fromUa: Parcels, goods and cargo from Ukraine
sub.delivery_europe: Transport between European and other countries

desc.food: A catalogue of departments opens: meat, fish, dairy, vegetables and fruit, groceries, bakery, sweets, preserves, drinks. Each department has search, filters by price, country and city, shops and sellers, and the buttons “Add listing” and “Add your own department”. A listing has a title, photos, description, price, quantity, country, region, city, contacts and delivery terms; from a department it lands there, from the section home page — after choosing a department.
desc.clothes: A catalogue of clothing categories; each has listings from different sellers and shops, search and filters, “Add listing” and “Add your own department”. A card shows photos, title, description, sizes, colour, price, availability, country, city, contacts and delivery terms.
desc.chemistry: A catalogue of household chemicals and home goods. Each folder has listings from different shops and sellers, an “Add listing” button and the option to suggest a new category.
desc.souvenirs: Ukrainian souvenirs, gifts, symbols and handmade items. Craftspeople, producers and shops add goods to the matching folders. A card shows photos, title, description, price, availability, features, point of sale and contacts; you can open the seller’s page and arrange an order.
desc.electro: Shops of electronics, appliances, electrical goods and equipment. Search by name, filters by price, specifications, country and city, link to the shop page. A card shows photos, title, description, specifications, price, warranty, availability, seller and delivery.
desc.delivery: Carriers, transport companies and people who need delivery: “Carriers from Ukraine abroad”, “Carriers across Europe and other countries” and “Submit a delivery request” (from and to, what, number of items, weight and size, date, terms, contacts). Carriers see requests and offer their services.
desc.abroad: An international network of Ukrainian shops and warehouses abroad. Only countries, regions and cities that already have partners are shown. A card shows the name, photos, address, products, services, contacts and hours. “Submit a cooperation request”: type, country, region and city, name, address, description, products, contacts, photos; after administration review the partner is added to the list.
desc.addSection: Suggest a new main section or a new department inside an existing one: name, type, which direction it belongs to, description of goods or services, required categories, country or city, contacts, photos. The administration reviews the request and decides.

text.info_about: Doctors, nutrition, sport, psychology, recovery and health goods — specialists who understand our people.
text.info_how: Choose a direction, find a specialist and request a consultation. Information here does not replace diagnosis or treatment: see a doctor for medical care.

health.intro: Doctors, nutrition, sport, psychology, recovery and health goods. This is information, not medical advice.

desc.doctors: Online doctor consultations. Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.nutrition: Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.sport: Online and in-person sessions are possible if the specialist offers them. Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.psychology: Specialists’ qualifications are verified for psychological services and requests are confidential. Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.recovery: In-person services (massage, injury recovery) are searched by country and city: only places with registered specialists are shown. Speech therapists work online and, if they wish, in person. Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.motherChild: Specialists for pregnancy, birth preparation and child care. Child massage therapists and rehabilitation specialists are searched by country and city; speech therapists work online. Services for children take account of age, parental consent and qualifications. Each folder offers specialist profiles (photo, education, qualification, experience, languages, format and price), “Request a consultation”, “Join the team” and the option to suggest a new direction. Qualifications and the right to practice are verified before a profile is published.
desc.shops: A catalogue of online shops and goods for health, sport, nutrition and care: categories, search by name, filters and sorting, product cards, seller contacts, order and delivery terms, and a shop application to join. Regulated goods are checked for legal compliance.

text.info_about: Helper for an hour: masters, loaders and tool rental near you.
text.info_how: Describe what needs doing and performers in your city will respond. Masters create a cabinet and form teams in a city, region or country. Agree terms and payment directly.
text.cabinet_create: Submit the “Become a master or specialist” application. After administrator review you get a cabinet: profile, services, orders, reviews and settings.

sub.masters: Catalogue of masters and specialists in your city
sub.cabinet: Registration, cabinet, teams and representative offices
sub.job: Earn with your own work or find a worker
sub.rent: Earn from tools and equipment you already own
sub.masters_furniture: Assembly, repair, installation and dismantling of furniture
sub.masters_garden: Mowing, tree trimming, vegetable garden, yard cleaning
sub.masters_firewood: Cutting, splitting and stacking firewood, odd jobs
sub.masters_transport: Loaders, drivers, moving furniture and things
sub.masters_misc: Other household services and one-off help
sub.job_find: Looking for someone to do a job
sub.job_need: A job needs doing: leave a request

desc.masters: Choose a job category, enter country, city or district and open a master’s profile: photos of work, description, experience, price, reviews. Buttons “Contact the master” and “Order a job”. A profile has contacts, services, schedule and reviews after an order.
desc.cabinet: People register here and offer their services. Form: name, country, region and city, field and specialty, services, experience, photos of work, contacts. After verification a personal cabinet opens: profile, services, prices and terms, photos, schedule, new orders, replies, active and finished jobs, messages, reviews. Teams and offices: country → region → city → local team. Specialist applications and representative-office applications are processed separately.
desc.job: Works for both sides: those who look for a worker and those who want to earn by working. “Find a worker” — choose the kind of job, country and city, view profiles and prices. “A job needs doing” — a request: what to do, place, date, budget, contacts. Examples: firewood, vegetable garden, mowing, trees, yard, moving, furniture, small repairs, household and building work.
desc.rent: List your own tools, equipment and machinery for rent. A listing has a title, photos, description and condition, country and city, price per hour, day or other term, conditions and deposit, delivery and contacts. A renter chooses equipment, enters a city, compares prices and terms, agrees with the owner and presses “Rent”.

text.info_about: Translators and translation of documents and texts by language and country.
text.info_how: Choose a language and submit a request with description and deadline. Send only a description via the form; hand over original documents directly to the translator after agreeing.

sub.translators: Find translators by language and field
sub.info: About the platform, team and partnership
sub.documents_official: Translation with the translator’s confirmed qualification and certification
sub.documents_ordinary: Certificates, applications, letters, contracts without official certification

desc.translators: Choose a language to open the catalogue of translators. A profile shows photo, translation languages, education and qualification, experience, fields (business correspondence, texts, study materials), format (online or offline), price, countries and cities, reviews. Buttons: “View profile”, “Request a translation or consultation”, “Contact the translator”, “Join the translators’ team”. You can also add a new language, suggest a field or become a translator; the administrator verifies and adds it to the catalogue.
desc.documents: A translation request: source and target language, document or text type, file or text, desired deadline, contacts. It goes to translators or the administrator; the reply has the price, deadlines and terms. For official translation you can choose a translator with a confirmed status in the required country. Clients’ documents are kept confidential.

text.info_about: Business Speed — a set of services to launch and grow a business: specialists, partners and other platform projects.
text.info_how: Pick business specialists, request partner matching or find a sales market. Administrators will respond to your request.

turnkey.intro: Business Speed — help starting and growing a business: specialists, partners, sales markets and platform projects.

sub.partners: Suppliers, goods, services and sales markets
sub.projects: All opportunities of our business ecosystem
sub.specialists_admin: Process organization, document flow, administrative support

desc.specialists: Our own team of specialists provides entrepreneurs with professional services remotely or in another format when needed, without keeping a staff. A category shows recommended specialists, their services, experience, countries and languages, contacts. Buttons: “View specialists”, “Request a service” (service, country and city, company or activity, task, one-off or ongoing, deadline, contacts), “Become our specialist”. Price, scope, the specialist’s pay and the platform’s fee are agreed transparently in advance.
desc.partners: An international base of businesses, producers, suppliers, shops and service companies on the platform. Choose a country (those with partners are shown), then a catalogue with search by product or service, activity, categories, filters by city or region and supplier type. An enterprise card has contacts, product catalogue and cooperation terms.
desc.projects: Shows which other platform projects are useful for your business: jobs, export alliance, China, shops and others, with help choosing a project.

text.info_about: A place where project authors, investors and specialists meet. The platform only introduces parties, takes no part in deals and guarantees no funding or profit.
text.info_how: Authors submit projects, investors create a profile (open or hidden), specialists offer services. Parties settle everything themselves; investing involves risk.

invest.intro: Projects, investors and specialists. The platform only introduces parties; investing involves risk.

sub.investors: Find investors and their investment capacity
sub.info: About the platform, cooperation and earning opportunities
sub.specialists_analyst: Analysis of investment opportunities and projects
sub.specialists_auditor: Review of financial documents and reporting
sub.specialists_valuation: Valuation of businesses, property and assets

desc.projects: A catalogue of projects checked by the administration. A card shows name, country, industry, short description, required amount, amount raised (if allowed), stage, contact person and investor-search status. The full page has the presentation, the problem solved, business model, funds needed and their use, plan and stages, financial forecasts, risks and conditions, documents. Buttons: “Apply to invest”, “Contact the representative”, “Get more information”, “Submit a project for placement”. Only approved projects are published.
desc.investors: A catalogue of the platform’s investors. A card shows name or company, country, fields, approximate budget, interesting industries, cooperation format and a contact request. A profile can be public or hidden (then only the administration sees it and proposals arrive privately). The budget is an approximate willingness to consider investing, not proof of funds or a commitment. Buttons: “View investors”, “Become an investor on the platform”.
desc.specialists: Each specialty has its own folder with a catalogue of experts. Specialists help prepare, launch, manage and grow investment projects. You can suggest a new specialty or become a specialist.

text.info_about: Tours, hot offers, tickets and insurance for our people.
text.info_how: Submit a request for a tour, holiday selection or tickets — the reply appears in “My requests”. Hot offers disappear after the date passes or when no seats remain.

travel.intro: Tours, hot offers, tickets and insurance. Pick a holiday or submit a request.

sub.hot_cancelled: Cancelled tours at a better price
sub.hot_prepaid: Already paid trips at a discount, if they can legally be re-registered
sub.hot_urgent: Nearest departure dates at special prices
sub.hot_promo: Promotions and discounts directly from tour operators

desc.turnkey: Ready trips with the hotel, flight, transfer, meals and excursions already planned. Choose a country and a tour, state the departure city, date and number of adults and children, and send a request; a travel specialist calculates the full price with all costs, then terms and booking are agreed.
desc.join: Planned group trips: destination, route, dates, meeting point, day-by-day programme, hotels, transport, meals, excursions, price, free seats, organizer contact. Buttons: “Detailed programme”, “Join the group”, “Request a seat booking”, “Ask the organizer”. A seat is taken after the booking is confirmed.
desc.pick: For those who have not yet chosen a country, hotel or tour. Request: desired country, departure city, dates or period, number of days, adults and children with ages, budget, hotel and meal wishes, type of holiday, other wishes, contacts. A specialist selects options according to your budget and wishes.
desc.hot: A catalogue of bargain offers: photo, title, country and resort, hotel, dates, departure city, free seats, old and new price (if the discount is confirmed), what is included, extra costs, booking and payment terms, validity. For cancelled and already paid tours, the possibility to change the tourist, refund and re-registration under the operator’s rules and contract is always checked.
desc.tickets: A request to search for and book tickets: from and to, date, return date, number of passengers, class or seat, luggage, contacts. A specialist finds options, sends the price and terms and, once agreed, helps make the booking.

text.info_about: Everything for pets: animals, shops, vets, training, grooming, pet sitting, travel and help for animals.
text.info_how: Choose an animal type and breed, shops or specialists, submit service requests. Check documents and terms before buying or boarding.
text.travel_docs: Before traveling with an animal check destination rules: microchip, rabies vaccination, veterinary certificate. Rules change — confirm with official services.
text.travel_rules: Carriers have their own rules on weight, carriers and breeds. Confirm terms with the airline or carrier in advance.

pets.intro: Animals, shops, vets, training, grooming, pet sitting and help for animals — all in one place.

sub.shops: Shops and goods for all kinds of animals
sub.walking: Walking, feeding and help at home
sub.grooming_shop: Clippers, scissors, shampoos, dryers, salon equipment
sub.grooming_learning: Bathing, brushing, nails, ears and eyes, home grooming
sub.grooming_onsite: Mobile groomers, mobile and stationary salons

desc.animals: A catalogue of animal listings. Each folder has “Post your listing” (species, breed, age, sex, country and city, photos, description, health and vaccination, listing type, contacts, terms of transfer) and shops for that kind of animal. Breeds are automatic subfolders: if a folder does not exist, the system offers to create it after administration review; a single reference list of species and breeds avoids duplicates.
desc.shops: A general catalogue of online shops for all kinds of animals. A shop page has name and logo, country and city, categories, product photos, description and prices, payment, delivery and returns, contacts, reviews. Buttons: “View shops”, “Find a product”, “Become a partner shop”, “Apply to open a shop”.
desc.vet: Vets for consultations and appointments. A profile has photo, education and qualification, experience, animal species, fields, languages, country and city, online or clinic, price, reviews. Buttons: “Request a consultation”, “Book an appointment”, “Join the vets’ team”. An online consultation does not replace an examination where physical diagnostics or emergency help is needed; qualifications are verified.
desc.training: A catalogue of dog handlers and trainers. A profile has photo, experience, specialty, breeds and age groups, individual or group lessons, online or offline, city, price. Buttons: “Find a trainer”, “Request a lesson”, “Join the trainers’ team”.
desc.grooming: Groomers, salons, groomer shops and training in self-care. For offline services choose a country and city. Buttons: “Request a service”, “Join the groomers’ team”, “Add your salon or shop”.
desc.sitting: For owners who need to leave an animal under supervision temporarily and for those providing such services. “I need pet sitting” — a request (species and breed, age, dates, city, wishes, contacts); “I can take a pet”; “Pet hotels”; private help and temporary care.
desc.walking: Dog walking, feeding and help at home: “I need a dog walker” (a request) and “I can walk dogs” (a performer’s form).
desc.travel: Animal transport, documents for travel, transport rules, pet-friendly hotels and a travel agency for trips with pets.
desc.nutrition: Nutrition for dogs, cats, birds, rodents, fish and reptiles, choosing food, diets and therapeutic nutrition, weight control, care consultations.
desc.support: Shelters, help for strays, volunteers, feeding shelters, fundraisers and funds, help for injured animals and owners, finding a new home, charities; you can suggest an organization or a fundraiser.

text.info_about: Fairs of Ukrainian products worldwide: producer and seller applications and fair organizers.
text.info_how: Producers apply, organizers in countries or cities form teams and venues. Participation in fairs is not guaranteed; details are agreed with the organizer.

trade.intro: Fairs of Ukrainian products abroad: producers apply, organizers form teams and venues.

sub.organizers_self: I have experience and am ready to organize events
sub.organizers_member: I want to be part of the international team
sub.organizers_venue: I can offer a location for a future event

desc.producers: A form for Ukrainian producers, entrepreneurs, farmers, craftsmen, shop owners and sellers: where you are (in Ukraine or abroad), your activity, which products you offer; from Ukraine — export documents, experience and target countries; from abroad — country, region, city, shop or warehouse, contacts and photos. Submitting does not mean automatic admission to sale: the requirements of the fair’s country apply.
desc.organizers: For Ukrainians in Ukraine and abroad who want to organize fairs in their cities: “I can organize on my own”, “Join the team”, “I have a venue”. The form: country, region, city, experience, readiness, venue, resources, contacts and links to past events. Applications are stored in the organizers’ base linked to country and city.

text.info_about: Interest clubs: hunters, anglers, pet lovers, drivers, motorcyclists, cyclists, knitting, cooking and pastry. Each club has communities by country and city, a bulletin board, shop, bloggers, courses, events and specialists.
text.info_how: Pick a club, join a local community or apply for a branch or representation. Applications for leadership, new clubs and directions are moderated. Only lawful goods and services are allowed.

clubs.intro: Interest clubs: chat, ads, shops, training, events and specialists in your city and country.

sub.interest: Find like-minded people, chat and create communities
sub.shops: Goods, shops and purchases by interest

desc.interest: Each club is a separate themed page with the same base: countries and communities (country → region → city, only those with members are shown), bulletin board, club shop, bloggers and live streams, online courses (amateur and certified), events and meetups, experts and specialists, joining the team. “Join the club” is a form; the geographic structure is added automatically after the application is confirmed. Applications to lead a branch or to represent the club are approved by the administration. A course certificate is not equivalent to a state qualification or licence.
desc.shops: Themed online shops for club interests: hunters, anglers, animals, cars, motorcycles, cyclists, knitting, cooking, pastry. Buttons: “View goods”, “Find a shop”, “Add a product”, “Open your own shop”, “Become a club partner”. Legal restrictions apply to regulated goods.

text.info_about: The Antiques shop brings together owners of antique and precious items, collectors, buyers, shops, appraisers, experts and masters from different countries.
text.info_how: Post listings in online shops, add an offline shop, find an appraiser or expert. The platform does not allow illegal trade in cultural property, archaeological finds or precious metals contrary to law; check provenance and export rules.

antiques.intro: Antiques and precious items: online and offline shops, appraisers, experts and masters. Illegal trade in cultural property is prohibited.

sub.things: Online and offline shops, antiques, collections and listings
sub.info: About the platform, cooperation, partnership and earnings
sub.feedback: Feedback, new direction suggestions, requests to the administration
sub.things_online: Catalogue of online shops and private sellers
sub.things_offline: Real antique shops by country and city
sub.experts_authors: Art, antiquity, history and authenticity of items

desc.things: Categories: art, coins and banknotes, antiquities, jewelry and precious items, porcelain and ceramics, watches, antique furniture, books and documents, collectibles, other. Buttons: “View listings”, “Post your listing” (title, category and subcategory, photos, description and period, condition, documents and provenance, price or “By agreement”, country and city, contacts, sale or exchange), “Open an online shop”, “Suggest a new subsection” (after administration review). Categories also offer “Find an appraiser” and “Request a valuation”.
desc.things_offline: First the countries that already have registered shops, then region (if given) and city. Shops without a region are not hidden. A shop page has name, logo, photos, address and map, description, categories, catalogue, contacts, hours, website and social links. “Add your offline shop” is an application; after administration review the shop appears in the list, and the owner may also open an online shop with a seller’s cabinet.
desc.experts: Themed folders with specialists’ profiles: appraisers (antiques, coins and banknotes, jewelry, precious metals and stones, paintings, watches, furniture, porcelain), experts, craftsmen and restorers. You can suggest a new profession or specialty.

text.info_about: The Ukrainian Export Alliance unites farmers, producers, suppliers, buyers, trade representatives and logistics partners. We unite. We cooperate. We reach world markets.
text.info_how: Choose a folder: farmers, suppliers or sales markets. Add a farm or company, create a sales request, find a buyer or carrier. Check your partner and documents before a deal; the platform takes no part in payments.

exportAlliance.intro: The Ukrainian Export Alliance unites farmers, producers, suppliers, buyers, trade representatives and logistics partners. We unite. We cooperate. We reach world markets.

desc.agro: Unites farmers, landowners and producers. Inside each field there are categories (for example berries: strawberry, raspberry, blueberry…), a producer catalogue with search and filters (country, region, city, volume, season). Buttons: “Add your farm”, “Find producers”, “Post products”, “Submit a sales-search request”, “Suggest a new category”. A farm card: name, logo or photo, region, areas, product types and volumes, harvest period, supply ability, certificates, contacts.
desc.suppliers: A catalogue of companies selling goods, equipment, machinery and materials to farmers. Subcategories (for example fertilizers: mineral, organic, NPK, micronutrients…). Buttons: “Find a product”, “View suppliers”, “Add a company”, “Post a product”, “Suggest a new category”. A product card: name, photo, characteristics, manufacturer, price or price request, wholesale terms, availability, certificates. Permits are checked for agrochemicals, seeds and plant protection products.
desc.markets: The main working part: “Create a sales-search request”, “Find a buyer”, “Offer help to a producer”. Eight folders: requests, markets in Ukraine, international markets, companies and buyers, representatives and partners, logistics, negotiations and commercial offers, successful deals. A request has 8 steps: product, volume, form, place of production, target market, buyers, logistics and terms, contacts and documents.

text.info_about: An international project for dating, communication and meetings for Ukrainians worldwide: meet people, find friends or a partner, travel and create new opportunities together.
text.info_earn: Organizing events and dates, streams and themed broadcasts, growing your channel, advertising and attracting participants. Partner rewards follow program rules only; income is not guaranteed.

dating.intro: An international project for dating, communication and meetings for Ukrainians worldwide.

sub.profiles: Browse profiles and submit your own
sub.hosts: Find streams and hosts and join
sub.info: How to join the team and earn
sub.dates_online10: Chatting with ten different people online
sub.dates_offline10: Real meetings in cities of Ukraine and other countries
sub.dates_groups: Individual and group dates, themed evenings
sub.dates_trips: For those who live in different cities or countries

desc.profiles: “Browse listings” shows profiles of people looking to meet. “Post a dating listing” creates your own: photo and short video, name, age, country and city, who you look for, about you and interests, format (online, offline or both). A profile has the button “I want to meet”. A profile can be edited, hidden or deleted.
desc.dates: Organized events. “10 online dates”: short form, age, country, city and wishes, application, organizers form groups and pairs. “10 offline dates”: choose a country and city, view planned meetings, apply (individual or group). “Individual and group dates”, “Romantic trips and meetings” (via the travel agency; terms and payment are agreed separately).
desc.hosts: A catalogue of dating hosts and organizers, bloggers and content authors, streamers and channels. A user can view a host’s profile and past streams, open the channel, subscribe and join a live stream. Hosts and bloggers apply and create their own page in the catalogue.
desc.travel: A separate service for meeting in person even if people are in different countries: romantic trips for two, a meeting in another city, flights and accommodation, group trips, a trip organization request. Terms, payment and booking are agreed separately.
desc.info: The idea of the project, how it works, how to earn (events and dates, streams, your own channel, advertising, attracting members, partner and referral rewards under programme rules), how to become an organizer in your city, a host or blogger, a partner, and apply to the team.

text.info_about: An international platform for mystic, esoteric and spiritual specialists, bloggers and hosts. Find a specialist, join an open broadcast or book a consultation.
text.info_earn: Own consultations, paid courses and workshops, themed events, live broadcasts, content, partner programs and advertising. Terms, commission and payouts are stated for each model; earnings are not guaranteed. Esoteric consultations are not medical, legal or financial help, and predictions are not guaranteed facts.

mystic.intro: Specialists, practitioners, broadcasts and training. Consultations do not replace medical, legal or financial help; predictions are not guaranteed facts.

sub.experts: Find a specialist, browse profiles, attend a stream or submit your own profile
sub.info: About the project, cooperation, partnership and earning
sub.feedback: Feedback, requests to the administration and problem reports
sub.experts_practices: Other practices and author methods with clearly described services
sub.experts_bloggers: Content authors, hosts of streams and themed programs

desc.experts: A catalogue of specialists by field. A card has photo, name or pseudonym, country and city, description, fields, format (online or offline), upcoming streams, “View profile”. Search and filters: name or field, country, city, language, format, live streams, sorting. A specialist page: “Watch live”, “Book a consultation”, “Message the specialist”, “Schedule of streams and events”, “My courses and training”. Streams: live now, scheduled, recordings, educational, questions to the specialist. Booking: service, terms, date and time, message; the price is shown before confirmation. “Submit a specialist profile” is for those who want to present themselves on the platform.

text.donors_howto: How to find grants, how grant support works, key rules and tips. Verify the grantor on its official site; nobody can guarantee a grant. Never pay for a “guaranteed grant”.
text.info_about: Purpose and options of the Grants section: one place to find funding, a specialist, help with an idea, partners and success stories. User information is published after administrator review.
text.info_earn: Specialists are paid for their services, consultants for consultations, partners for agreed partner services. Terms and commissions are transparent and agreed separately; income is not guaranteed.
text.info_learning: Materials, instructions and training programs on preparing grant applications will appear here.

grants.intro: Grants, grantors, grant writing specialists and success stories. The platform does not guarantee any grant.

sub.donors: Where to find grants and who gives them
sub.success_veterans: Support for veterans and their initiatives
sub.success_business: Grants to start and grow a business

desc.donors: Pinned info: how to search for grants and how grant support works. Then state, international, NGO, business, ideas and startups, and funds. Each grantor is a separate card: name, country or region, purposes, who may apply, amount, deadlines, website, application link, contacts, terms. Buttons: “Details”, “Go to site”, “Apply”, “Save to favourites”, “Share”, “Suggest an update”. “Add a grant or grantor” is open to members; everything is moderated to prevent fake grants.
desc.writers: Specialists by field: agriculture, business, NGOs, veteran projects, education, medicine, ecology, culture and sport, IT, territorial communities. A card has name, specialty, services (grant search, consultations, writing applications, support), experience, “Message the specialist”, “View profile”. The profile has services, reviews, contacts, “Ask for help”. “Become a grant specialist” is a profile application.
desc.success: Real stories and results. A post has the organization or project, the problem solved, the funder, the amount, what the money was spent on, who helped with the application, photos of implementation, the result. “Add a successful project” goes through moderation.
desc.help: Help preparing a grant application: “Help me write a grant”, “I have a grant idea”, “Help me find a grant”, “I represent an organization”, “I need a consultation”, “My applications”.

text.info_about: An international platform for beauty masters, specialists, teachers, bloggers and shops. Find specialists, book services, learn and grow your own business.
text.info_earn: Masters get clients and bookings, teachers sell training, bloggers get audience and advertising, shops sell goods. Partner programs, advertising and commissions apply only on agreed terms; income is not guaranteed.
text.info_teamTraining: Instructions and training materials for the project team will appear here.

beauty.intro: Masters, training, shops and jobs in the beauty industry. A course document is not a medical license or permission for invasive procedures.

sub.specialists: Find a master, browse profiles, book a service
sub.education: Courses, teachers, study groups and events
sub.work: Vacancies, job search, clients and workplace rental
sub.feedback: Ideas, requests and contact with the administration
sub.cabinet: My bookings, messages, profile and settings

desc.specialists: A catalogue of beauty fields. Search: profession, service or name, country, city, online or offline. Each field (for example “Manicure and pedicure”) has the same structure: masters with profiles, prices and booking, portfolios, teachers and trainers, bloggers, live streams, a bulletin board, shops and goods, “Add yourself”. A profile has photo, name and profession, verification status, country, city and address, map, services and prices, photos of work, video, reviews, schedule; buttons “Choose date and time”, “Message the specialist”, “Add to favourites”.
desc.education: Professional programs, teachers, training centres and international events. Search by country, city, field, format (online or offline) and date. Fields: medical cosmetology, injection, skin care, hairdressing, manicure, make-up, device-based cosmetology and others.
desc.shops: Cosmetics and care, goods for nails and hairdressers, equipment, professional products, salon furniture, manufacturers, news and professional discounts. “Add your shop” is an application.

text.info_about: An international publishing project about Ukrainians, their achievements, stories and records. Two publications: the magazine and the Ukrainian Book of Records; the magazine is issued quarterly with an annual special edition.
text.info_how: Candidate selection, verification of information and evidence, editorial work and publication. Personal materials are published only with the person’s consent and editorial review; applying does not mean automatic recognition of a record.
text.info_earn: Opportunities for editors, journalists, photographers, videographers, designers, managers, representatives and coordinators: job description, requirements, format and payment terms are stated separately. Registration or joining the team does not guarantee income.

notable.intro: Stories of notable Ukrainians, their achievements and records. Materials are published only with the person’s consent.

sub.magazine_nextIssue: Candidates who passed selection and are being prepared for publication
sub.magazine_apply: Tell about yourself or suggest another person

desc.magazine: A publication about outstanding Ukrainians: stories, achievements, career path, civic and volunteer work. Three folders: Ukrainians of the next issue (a card has photo, name, country and city, field, achievements, link to the page; a personal page with biography, merits, materials), editorial specialists (editor-in-chief, editors, journalists, photographers, designers and others), an application for publication — about yourself or another person.
desc.records: A chronicle of Ukrainians’ records and achievements. Folders: Ukrainians of the next issue, chronicle specialists, an application for a record or a record-holder suggestion, my applications and statuses.
desc.archive: A digital archive of published magazines and books.

text.laws_howto: Statuses are shown separately so a bill is not confused with a law in force: pending, adopted, rejected, in force. Each post names the author, country, date, source and date of verification.
text.info_about: An international media network where every active person can become a news author, journalist or blogger for their community. Everyone can not only read but also create material and grow an audience.
text.info_earn: Cooperation terms, partnerships and reward models are approved separately; earnings are not guaranteed.

mediaNetwork.intro: An international media network: authors, events, laws, community life. Materials are moderated.

sub.authors: People who tell interesting stories and run their own blogs
sub.events: Events from different countries, videos and reports
sub.laws: Laws, changes and explanations of their status
sub.life: Practical information for life in different countries and cities
sub.info: Opportunities for cooperation, participation and team growth

desc.authors: A catalogue of authors with their own pages (not a general feed). An author page: photo and name, about, country, region, city, blog and materials, “Subscribe”, “Bulletin board”, new posts. Search by name or topic; filters by country, region, city and field.
desc.events: An international feed of events: good news, important problems, reports. “+ Add event”: video, photos, title, description, date and time, country, region, city, community, place, category. Statuses: “Under review” → approved or rejected with an explanation. Posts appear in the country, region and city; search and geographic filters are available.
desc.laws: Laws and bills with an explanation of their status.
desc.life: Practical information: work, housing, documents and community life in different countries and cities.

text.earn_business: Creating enterprises and cooperative farms. Describes activity, cooperation terms, required resources, how to join and income principles, plus risks and costs. Income is not guaranteed by joining: it depends on the project, contracts and profit distribution.
text.earn_production: Growing, processing and selling products within cooperative projects. Terms, risks and profit distribution are set per project; income is not guaranteed.
text.earn_building: Works, services and joint construction projects. Payment terms and liabilities are fixed by contract; income is not guaranteed.
text.earn_partnership: Finding partners, orders and clients. Parties agree cooperation terms; income is not guaranteed.

cooperatives.intro:
We unite people, deliver projects, rebuild the country and create opportunities worldwide.
An international platform for joint cooperatives, finding land, housing and farms to restore, business projects and teams of specialists. Income is not guaranteed by joining alone.

sub.land: Opportunities in Ukraine and other countries
sub.land_programs: State, municipal and private programs in different countries
sub.land_add: Tell the community about a new offer
sub.specialists_it: Platform development, automation and digital solutions
sub.specialists_other: All other professions needed to deliver projects
sub.specialists_createTeam: Propose your own team for a specific cooperative project
sub.earn_building: Works, services and joint construction projects

desc.projects: Cooperative projects that are already being developed, organized or implemented are published here. Open a project, read the full details and join the team.
desc.projects_list:
Each project includes: name; country and city; short description and goal; stage; required resources and specialists; number of participants (if public); contacts of the responsible organizer.

How to join: open the project → read the information → press “Join the team” → state your skills, experience and availability → the request goes to the organizer, who contacts you and decides.
desc.land:
An international base of opportunities for Ukrainians looking for land, housing, settlements, farms or territories to create cooperatives and live and work together.

Filters: country; city or locality; type of opportunity; free, preferential, rent or purchase; housing available; land available; possibility to create a cooperative; terms for Ukrainians; state or municipal support.

Reliability labels: official program, confirmed offer, private listing, information under review.
desc.land_add:
Found a program offering Ukrainians houses, land plots or abandoned settlements? Tell the community.

In the form state: country; city or locality; what is offered (land, houses, village, farm, relocation program); link to the original source or official site; organization contacts; participation terms; photos and documents; whether a cooperative can be created; your contact details.

After submission the request goes to the administration for review (statuses: “Under review”, “Confirmed”, “Not confirmed”, “Archive”). Once confirmed, the information is published in the shared database.
desc.specialists: A shared base of specialists who can take part in cooperative projects. Choose a section, find a specialist or join a team as a specialist.
desc.specialists_builders:
Find a specialist: browse profiles, search by country, city and profession, check experience and qualifications, send a cooperation request.
Join a team: fill in a profile with your specialty, experience, country of residence and field; the request goes to the team leader.

Find a specialist: browse profiles, search by country, city and profession, check experience and qualifications, send a cooperation request.
Join a team: fill in a profile with your specialty, experience, country of residence and field; the request goes to the team leader.

Join a team: fill in a profile with your specialty, experience, country of residence and field; the request goes to the team leader.
desc.earn:
Here we explain how you can earn by taking part in cooperative projects: apply your knowledge, profession, resources, business skills or investment.

Each section covers: how the direction works, what it opens up, required skills, how to join, terms of cooperation, how income is formed, and risks and costs to consider.

Income is not guaranteed by joining alone: it depends on the specific project, contracts, results and profit sharing.
desc.feedback: An open channel between cooperative members, organizers and the administration. Choose a category, describe the situation and attach documents or photos if needed. You get a request number and can track its status: new, accepted, needs clarification, reviewed, closed. Requests are confidential and visible only to authorized administrators.

text.info_about: An international platform uniting Ukrainians around apps, programs and games: share useful apps, propose ideas, find developers and testers, build teams.
text.info_earn: Participation, reward and revenue-sharing rules are set for each joint project. Registration does not guarantee payment.

apps.intro: Apps, ideas, developers and testers. The “Our developments” showcase contains the project’s own products only.

sub.apps: Interesting and useful apps from different countries
sub.ideas: Ideas, finding partners and joint development
sub.ours: Our apps, games and digital products

desc.apps: First the countries where apps have been published, then a feed: finance, travel and navigation, learning, other. “+ Add an app”: name, link, the country where you use it; the author is taken from the profile. If the country is missing, you can suggest adding it; after review it becomes available.
desc.ideas: A place for ideas, unfinished apps and games: “I have an app idea”, “I want to create a game”, “I have an unfinished app”, “Looking for partners”. “+ Add your idea”: title, what to create, detailed description, a new idea or a ready development.
desc.people: Developers, designers, game developers, testers. “Apply as a specialist” and “I want to become a tester”.

text.earn_building: Participation in construction and restoration projects. Charity programs, paid work, commercial orders and investments are different things: terms and payment are stated separately; income is not guaranteed.
text.earn_production: Creating enterprises and production. Describes needed resources, who can join, how pay or profit is formed and where to apply.
text.earn_supply: Supply of building materials, equipment and products. Parties agree cooperation terms.
text.earn_partnership: Cooperation with foreign funds and companies. Terms and documents are agreed separately.

rebuild.intro: We unite international funds, organizations, businesses and people to rebuild Ukraine.

sub.intl: Who wants to help and enter Ukraine
sub.ua: Who is ready to cooperate and unite
sub.projects: Completed and current projects and formed teams
sub.intl_funds: Funds ready to finance Ukraine’s rebuilding
sub.intl_ngos: Organizations seeking partners for humanitarian and social programs
sub.intl_investors: Companies that want to open enterprises and invest in Ukraine
sub.intl_builders: Construction, manufacturing, engineering and technology companies
sub.intl_suppliers: Equipment, food, materials, machinery and other resources
sub.ua_ngos: Organizations ready to carry out international aid programs
sub.ua_business: Companies ready to cooperate with international business and funds
sub.ua_teams: People who can organize help on the ground

desc.intl: An international base of funds, charities, NGOs, investors and companies that want to help and enter Ukraine. A card has name, country and city, logo, description, fields, contacts, website, documents, what they offer and which Ukrainian partners they seek. “Submit a cooperation offer”: field, what help is offered, which partners and regions are needed, contacts, links, presentations.
desc.ua: A base of Ukrainian organizations, enterprises, teams and people ready to join international aid and rebuilding programs. It complements the first folder: there, who seeks partners; here, who can become them.
desc.projects: Completed projects, ongoing projects, formed teams and directions.

sub.team: Teams and representative offices in countries, regions and districts

desc.network: Choose online or offline, then country → region → district → city. The leader of each level (photo, contacts, cabinet) is shown at the top. If a team exists — “Join the team”; if not — “Apply to create a representative office”. The list of countries, regions and leaders is managed by the administration. Lawyer profiles are published after their documents and right to practice are verified.
